invariants.rationale: The method expects a list of records to be bulk inserted, so it is likely this parameter is not null.
The instantTime identifies the commit instant for the operation; it would not make sense for it to be null.
A valid execution context is required and is not expected to be null when this API is called.
A Java List's size() is always non-negative.
An Option object representing the BulkInsertPartitioner parameter should be non-null, even if it represents an empty value.
